about.summary: Main function "decode" is used to decode coded key values to plain text. Function "code" can be used to code plain text to code if there is a 1:1 relation between the two. The concept relies on 'keyvalue' objects used for translation. There are several 'keyvalue' objects included in the areas of geographical regional codes, administrative health care unit codes, diagnosis codes and more. It is also easy to extend the use by arbitrary  code sets.

name: r-decoder
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "1.2.3" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-decoder
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/decoder_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/decoder/decoder_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 256e3a066a659f21885e1d8375a923a2e0bc7034e2b0a36cc034245b47f7566c

build:
  noarch: generic
  number: 0
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-backports
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-backports

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('decoder')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('decoder')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://www.bitbucket.com/cancercentrum/decoder
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  summary: Main function "decode" is used to decode coded key values to plain text. Function "code" can be used to code plain text to code if there is a 1:1 relation between the two. The concept relies on 'keyvalue' objects used for translation. There are several 'keyvalue' objects included in the areas of geographical
    regional codes, administrative health care unit codes, diagnosis codes and more. It is also easy to extend the use by arbitrary  code sets.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file: {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
